sourceSentences: Upon taking death [fatal damage], Karthus enters a zombie state for 7 seconds, during which he can cast his abilities at no cost. If Defile has been learned, it will remain toggled on for Death Defied's entire duration. Requiem becomes disabled after 4 seconds of the duration have elapsed.

While under this state, Karthus becomes untargetable and cc-immune as well as prevents all incoming damage, but is also rendered unable to move, declare basic attacks, use summoner spells, and activate items.
Karthus cannot be executed by the during Death Defied.
Karthus conjures a blast at the target location that detonates after, granting sight of the area and dealing magic damage to all enemies within, when only one target is struck.
Enemies that touch the wall are inflicted with 25% magic resistance reduction and become slowed for 5 seconds, decaying over the duration.
Toggling Defile off triggers a final tick of damage.
Karthus channels for 3 seconds, then deals magic damage to all targetable enemy champions upon completion.
Requiem's channel is telegraphed to all enemy champions by a beam of light that descends on all targets, including if they are untargetable or even dead.

For a combo, turn on E and then W on the opponent, which is very important for lowering their magic resistance. After that, just spam Q, but be sure to right-click to also auto-attack. Then either kill them or, if you die, use two or three more Qs and your ultimate.

when an enemy champion is within your E range, first take E, then W, Q, auto- Q, and just keep using auto-Q until the end of the exchange. If they are further away, out of range of your E, you need to start with your W, then Q, activate E when they are in range, then do auto Q again
If you want to steal Baron on Carthus, what you want to do is Q flash smite by queuing first, getting the isolated Q on Baron, and then flash smiting it. They will never expect your damage
hold your W instead of using it uh early and just wait for the enemy to flash and then you use your W to secure a free kill with your slow.
